prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Teresa Li, Law Offices of Teresa Li
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer based only on directory listings and online reviews. A practical next step is to speak with **two or three attorneys who regularly handle car-injury cases**, then choose the one who clearly explains your options and will personally oversee the case.

A few Pleasanton-area options to compare are:

- **Paulo Kline Simon, The Kline Simon Law Firm** — Pleasanton; listed for personal injury and car accidents. [Profile](https://www.avvo.com/attorneys/94566-ca-paulo-klinesimon-3563765.html)
- **David Duncan, Duncan Law Firm** — Pleasanton; listed for car accidents and personal injury. [Profile](https://www.avvo.com/attorneys/94588-ca-david-duncan-4469491.html)
- **Stephen M. Fuerch** — Pleasanton; handles personal injury and car-accident matters. [Firm information](https://www.fuerchlegal.com/practice-areas/personal-injury/)
- **Teresa Li, Law Offices of Teresa Li** — Pleasanton office; handles car accidents and other injury claims. [Firm listing](https://lawyers.findlaw.com/california/pleasanton/law-offices-of-teresa-li-pc-NTI0MTkyMF8x/)

These are starting points, not endorsements; directory ratings and testimonials aren’t a substitute for checking fit and credentials. Before hiring, verify the lawyer’s current license and disciplinary history through the [State Bar of California attorney search](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/). In consultations, ask who will handle your case day to day, their experience with cases like yours, the contingency fee and case costs, and what happens if you don’t recover money. Don’t sign until you understand the fee agreement.

Keep copies of medical records, bills, photos, and insurance communications, and avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer before getting advice. If you share when the crash happened, how serious the injuries are, and whether insurance has contacted you, I can help you narrow down what to ask.
